metadata.title: PageTableCapsule: Lockfree GPU Memory Management Design
metadata.portability: 70-80% Linux i915 GTT → CapsuleOS page tables

answer.problem: GPU page table management requires lockfree atomic operations for: 1. Virtual→Physical address translation (GTT - Graphics Translation Table) 2. TLB invalidation coordination (flush protocol across GPU cores) 3. Page fault handling (lockfree fault queue) 4. Concurrent mapping/unmapping (driver threads + GPU hardware)
answer.current-approach: Traditional GPU drivers use: - Spinlocks (i915 GTT: spin_lock(&dev_priv->mm.gtt_lock)) - Mutex for page table updates (10-50μs overhead) - Sequential TLB invalidation (blocking all GPU cores) - Kernel-side synchronization (syscall overhead)

bottlenecks.bottleneck: Lock contention on hot-path mapping operations (10-50μs per lock)
TLB flush synchronization (barrier across all GPU cores, 1-10ms)

atomic-operations.operation: Page table entry (PTE) update (64-bit GPU VA → Physical Addr + Flags)
TLB generation counter (even = valid, odd = invalidation in-progress)
Mapping generation counter (detect stale TLB entries, TOCTOU prevention)
Page fault queue (lockfree circular buffer, head/tail atomics)
Reference counting (GPU buffer refcount for multi-mapping)

rationale.reason: PTE updates visible atomically (no torn reads by GPU MMU)
TLB flush coordination without blocking (odd gen = flush pending)
TOCTOU prevention (mapping gen changed → retry translation)
Lockfree fault queue (multiple GPU cores signal faults concurrently)

invariants.invariant: Coherency: PTE update → TLB flush → GPU sees new mapping
Atomicity: PTE write is atomic 64-bit (no torn reads by GPU MMU)
Ordering: Release semantics on PTE write (all prior writes visible)
TLB Consistency: Generation counter prevents stale TLB hits
Use-After-Unmap: Refcount > 0 before GPU access (prevents UAF)
ABA Prevention: Generation counter on every mapping change
Fault Ordering: Faults processed in-order per GPU context

q4-q9.question: Critical paths, error modes, complexity, scale, constraints, success criteria

path.name: Command submission mapping
path.operations: Lookup existing mapping (20ns) OR create new PTE (300ns) + TLB flush (100ns)

path.name: Page fault handling
path.operations: Fault queue pop (50ns) + allocate physical page (2μs) + map PTE (300ns) + TLB flush (100ns)

path.name: Buffer unmapping (cleanup)
path.operations: Clear PTE (100ns) + TLB flush (100ns) + refcount decrement (10ns)

error.name: Stale TLB hit (GPU uses old mapping after unmap)
error.prevention: Generation counter on PTE: GPU checks gen before use, mismatch → TLB flush
error.detection: TLB generation mismatch during lookup → return None, trigger flush

error.name: Use-after-unmap (GPU accesses unmapped memory)
error.prevention: Refcount on GPU buffer: unmap waits for refcount == 0 (GPU idle)
error.detection: Refcount check before unmap: if > 0 → delay unmap until GPU sync

error.name: TOCTOU race (mapping changes between check and use)
error.prevention: Mapping generation counter: load gen + PTE atomically, retry if gen changed
error.detection: Compare mapping_gen before/after lookup: mismatch → retry

error.name: Page fault queue overflow
error.prevention: 2048-entry circular buffer with backpressure (stall GPU if full)
error.detection: Head == tail + queue_size → GPU fence until space available

q6-complexity.metric: Coordination complexity: HIGH (GPU MMU + CPU driver + TLB coherency)
Concurrency: HIGH (4+ CPU threads + 512-2048 GPU threads)

Error handling: HIGH (7 invariants, 4 error modes, 3 recovery paths)

Page fault rate: 10-100 per second (depends on overcommit)
Concurrent accessors: 4-16 CPU threads + 512-2048 GPU threads

Safety: 99.5%+ ASSUM compliance (every atomic operation documented)

q10.question: Which capsule tier?

analysis.operation: Page table entry update (atomic PTE write + TLB coordination)

characteristics.char: Lockfree coordination required (CPU driver + GPU MMU)
Batch operations for bulk mapping (DMA buffer setup)

decision.primary-tier: T1 Atomic (lockfree PTE updates, TLB generation)
decision.secondary-tier: T4 Batch (bulk mapping for large DMA buffers)
decision.compound: T6 Mixed (T1 Atomic coordination + T4 Batch throughput)

rationale.reason: T1 Atomic: Critical path is single PTE update (64-bit atomic store)
T4 Batch: Bulk mapping amortizes TLB flush cost (1 flush per 256 PTEs)
T6 Mixed: DualAtomicU64 coordination + batch loop for bulk ops

q10.selected-tier: T1 Atomic (primary) + T4 Batch (bulk ops) = T6 Mixed

q11.question: Rust patterns for lockfree page tables?

pattern.name: DualAtomicU64 Coordination

implementation.field: tlb_generation: AtomicU64 (even = valid, odd = flush pending)

pattern.usage: Load both atomically (Acquire), check parity, retry if odd gen

pattern.name: Lockfree Page Table Entry (PTE)
pattern.usage: CAS loop for PTE update: compare_exchange(old_entry, new_entry, Release, Relaxed)

pattern.name: Lockfree TLB Flush Protocol

implementation.step: 1. Increment TLB gen (even → odd): mark flush pending
3. Increment TLB gen (odd → even): mark flush complete

pattern.usage: Readers check TLB gen parity: odd → retry after flush

pattern.name: Trait-Based HAL Abstraction

q12.question: Nightly features needed?

feature.name: atomic_from_mut
feature.justification: Zero-copy atomic view over GPU page table memory (mmap'd GTT)
feature.impact: Eliminates allocation overhead for PTE arrays (0ns vs 1-10μs)

feature.name: portable_simd (optional)
feature.justification: Batch PTE clearing (unmap 8 PTEs in parallel with u64x8)
feature.impact: 4-8× faster bulk unmap (not critical path, optional optimization)

feature.name: const_fn_trait_bound (optional)
feature.justification: Compile-time page size validation (4KB/2MB/1GB page alignment)
feature.impact: Compile-time safety check (0ns runtime, prevents misaligned PTEs)

q12.recommendation: Use atomic_from_mut (MANDATORY), defer SIMD/const_fn to Phase 2

tier.name: Q1-Q7: Unit Tests
tier.test: PTE packing/unpacking correctness (40-bit PA, 8-bit flags, 16-bit gen)
TLB generation parity check (even = valid, odd = flush pending)
Lookup returns None when TLB flush pending (odd generation)

tier.name: Q8-Q14: Property Tests
tier.test: TOCTOU prevention: Concurrent map/lookup never see torn state
ABA prevention: Generation counter prevents PTE reuse
TLB consistency: Stale TLB never returns old mapping after flush
Refcount safety: Unmap waits for GPU idle (refcount == 0)
Proptest: Random VA sequences, verify no data races

tier.name: Q15-Q21: Integration Tests
tier.test: Concurrent TLB flush + map/unmap (no deadlock, no stale TLB)
Page fault handling (lockfree fault queue, 2048 entries)
Large buffer mapping (1GB DMA buffer, 256K PTEs, batch TLB flush)
Loom model checking (all atomic orderings validated)

tier.name: Q22-Q28: Production Tests
tier.test: GPU command submission stress (10K commands/sec, 5 minutes)
Memory overcommit simulation (page fault storm, 1000 faults/sec)
Crash recovery (verify no leaked mappings, no orphaned PTEs)
